capacity_calibration.rationale: UN11 official bases confirm minimum fleet of 27 buses but accessible documents reviewed so far do not provide a verified passenger capacity for the awarded vehicles.

demand_calibration.limitations: Demand is constrained by published aggregates, not assigned from EOD microdata or observed 2025 boardings.
rationale: EOD/PMTP reports 91,372 bus-urban trips in Gran Valparaiso during punta manana
